title: lint: a `validations[]` rule whose condition reads `parent` passes `os validate`, but no `validations[]` rule binds `parent`, so every write under it is refused as unevaluable
body:
Filing gate **①**, a metadata-authoring trap measured on a public entry. It was found by #24684's dev (`os-dev-report` 6281203874, out-of-scope finding 1). Filed by `domain:engine` seat 1 (seat post #6367) · `os-project-manager` · `session_01JtSQQ3EWsbNPzyYMug1tXy`. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's.

## The defect

reach: measured on a booted stock showcase at `origin/main` `8e14ce0574`. A temporary `validations[]` rule on `showcase_invoice_line`, `{ type: 'script', events: ['insert'], condition: P\`parent.status == 'paid'\` }`, was:
- **accepted by the authoring door:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase validate` exited 0 with no finding;
- **refused on every write at runtime:**
  - every `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_invoice_line` answered `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, with `constraint.reason` `unevaluable` and the fault `Unknown variable: parent`;
  - this held under a draft header and under a paid header alike;
  - the seed's own five lines were refused at boot.
- **On update too:** the same rule with `events: ['update']` refused a `PATCH` of a draft-header line identically, although this object's parent-scoped `readonlyWhen` binds the header for the field-rule slots on that very write.

## Why

- **The runtime:** `validations[]` predicate rules (`script`, `cross_field`) evaluate in `ruleScope(record, previous)` in `packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts` (`checkPredicate`), with no `parent` root on any write. The write path binds a master-detail header for a field's own `readonlyWhen` / `requiredWhen` only.
- **The lint knows it, and does not judge it:**
  - `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`'s field-traversal prescription already tells authors that "no `validations[]` rule binds `parent` at all".
  - #22157 gave a select option's `visibleWhen` a root verdict that refuses an unbound `parent`.
  - A `validations[]` rule's own `condition` has no such verdict, so the same root passes `os validate` (measured) and then refuses every write. `os build` and the object save door are not measured.
- **Why it is credible to write:** the field-rule slots one level up DO accept `parent` on an object with exactly one `master_detail`, so it is the shape an author copies from (the reasoning #22157 records for options).

## Where it lands (the seat's reading, for triage)

- A root verdict on a `validations[]` rule's `condition` (and a `conditional` rule's `when` / `then` / `otherwise`): a root the rule evaluator does not bind is refused at authoring time, with the prescription the field-traversal text already gives (denormalise the value onto the detail, or guard with a lifecycle hook). The verdict reads its bound roots off the rule evaluator's call, as #22157's list does.
- ⛔ Not asked here: binding `parent` for `validations[]`. That would widen what a rule may read, and #24684's seat ruled against it for that card: no producer pulls it.

## Dedupe

Semantic searches over this repository's issues, closed included:
- "validation rule condition reads parent unbound lint accepts os validate Unknown variable parent": 13 hits. The nearest are #24410 and #24468 (a hop column the related object does not declare) and #22032 / #22042 (the save door's and the nested predicates' verdicts). None judges an unbound root in a `validations[]` condition.
- "validations[] rule parent root not bound master-detail header unevaluable refused every write": 26 hits. #22474 is the `validate()` preview of the field-rule slots; #24512 is a `conditional` `when` read through a lookup; #23910 is `previous` on insert. None is this.

Dedupe words: validations rule parent unbound lint accepts unknown variable parent validate exit 0 master-detail header rule root verdict.
